name: ListFaceGroups

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the media set
parameters.name: set_id

parameters.help_en: The marker from which the face group list is returned in lexicographic order. If this parameter is not specified, the list is returned from the beginning
parameters.help_zh: 从Marker开始按字典序返回人脸分组信息列表。如果不设置此参数，则从头开始返回人脸分组信息
parameters.name: marker

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of face groups to return. Default value: 20. Valid values: 1 to 100
parameters.help_zh: 返回人脸分组的最大个数，默认值为20，取值范围为1~100
parameters.name: limit

parameters.help_en:
The sort order. Default value: DESC. Valid values:

ASC: ascending order.
DESC: descending order
parameters.help_zh:
排序方式，默认值为DESC。

ASC：升序
DESC：降序
parameters.name: order

parameters.help_en:
The field by which to sort the results. Default value: FaceCount. Valid values:

CreateTime: the creation time of the face group.
ModifyTime: the modification time of the face group.
FaceCount: the number of faces in the face group
parameters.help_zh:
排序字段，默认值为FaceCount。

CreateTime：人脸分组的创建时间。
ModifyTime：人脸分组的修改时间。
FaceCount：人脸分组中的人脸数量
parameters.name: order_by

parameters.help_en:
The query condition for remarks. The following four query methods are supported. You can select one or more conditions as needed.

PREFIX: prefix match.
NOT-PREFIX: non-prefix match.
IN: exact match. The value must exactly match any of the strings specified in IN.
NOT-IN: exact match. The value must not match any of the strings specified in NOT-IN
parameters.help_zh:
标记信息查询条件，包括如下四种查询方式，可根据实际选择其中若干项条件进行查询。

PREFIX：前缀匹配。
NOT-PREFIX：非前缀匹配。
IN：全字匹配，必须完全符合IN中指定的任意一个字符串。
NOT-IN：全字匹配，必须不符合NOT-IN中指定的任意一个字符串
